content.comment_body: Ensure your SIM card is not restricted to LTE-only mode, as this limits available network functions such as email, NTP, and openVPN to specific [product_name] versions like [product_name] [version_no]. Additionally, the [product_name] module requires a SIM card with an active PIN; please enter the SIM card PIN on your smartphone for verification.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges with the cellular connection setup on the [product_name] module, even after configuring all settings as instructed. There is uncertainty about the compatibility of SIM cards, particularly regarding LTE-only capabilities and the necessity of entering a PIN, which affects successful connection. The features available depend on the version of the module, leading to confusion about the correct settings and requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a simple and reliable process for configuring cellular connectivity when all fields are completed. They expect clear instructions regarding SIM card specifications and necessary steps for successful connection.
